name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance in Rent to MSEs
briefDescription: The "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs" aims to empower the state's dynamic MSME sector, which significantly contributes to employment, GDP, and exports.
descriptionMd: The "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for MSMEs" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat. It aims to empower the state's dynamic MSME sector, which significantly contributes to employment, GDP, and exports. Effective from October 5, 2022, to October 4, 2027, this initiative supports growth, investments, and the vision of "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat" and "Aatmanirbhar Bharat." The component "Assistance in Rent to MSEs" provides financial assistance to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) that acquire rented or leased sheds to set up manufacturing activities. The assistance is provided in the form of a reimbursement of the rent paid during the operative period of the scheme.
benefitsMd: - **Reimbursement of Rent Paid:** Enterprises will receive assistance covering 65% of rent paid, with a maximum limit of ₹1,00,000/- per annum for a 5 years period.
eligibilityMd:
1. Only Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) involved in manufacturing activities are eligible.
   1. The enterprise must have obtained acknowledgment or registration from the Ministry of MSME or the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), as applicable.
   1. The enterprise should have a valid rent deed or lease agreement for the shed used for manufacturing activities.
   1. The manufacturing activity should consume electricity/power for its operations.
applicationMd:
> **Registration Process:** **Step-1:** Visit the [Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP)](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/) portal. Click on "New Investor Registration" to access the registration form. **Step-2:** Fill in the Registration Form. Click on "Submit". **Step-3:** Verify the E-mail ID using the link sent on your registered E-mail ID. **Step-4:** After verification, you will be registered successfully.
> **Post-Registration Process:** **Step-1:** Visit the [Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP)](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/) portal. Click on "Login". **Step-2:** Enter the email address and password you used during registration. **Step-3:** Click the "Login" button to access your account. **Step-4:** Now fill in the required details and mandatory documents about your business to complete the application process.
> **Helpdesk****:** [Contact Here.](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/IFP-pages/contact.jsp?pagedisp=static)
